name: Dev-via-spec Challenger Raised Concerns — Retry Planner
description: When the dev-via-spec-challenger emits decide(action=concerns_raised), the adversarial probe surfaced falsifiable concerns the planner must address. This rule fires on that signal and respawns the dev-via-spec-planner with the concerns. The planner reads the concerns via read_loop_result on the challenger loop and revises. Bounded by max_iterations=5 with the same per-entity caveat as rule 02. R3.3 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-plan-retry
on_enter.prompt: The dev-via-spec challenger raised concerns about the prior plan. Challenger loop id: $entity.instance. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to read the concerns list (the challenger's decide reason field), then revise the plan per your `20-revision-rules.md`. Treat each concern as a falsifiable claim — split coarse epics, prune creep items, add coverage for missing failure modes.

metadata.stop_condition: Q2 — MaxIter (=5) + challenger + opt-in human gate
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity caveat applies as in rule 02. The combined retry budget for reviewer + challenger gates is up to 10 round-trips; in practice the OSH journey settles in 1-2 retries per gate.
